programmes.specialization: Management Science and Operations (doctoral research area)
programmes.evidence: The central PhD/MPhil degree entry and separate PhD research-area inventory explicitly name Management Science and Operations as one of seven doctoral areas. All doctoral researchers join an academic group; the named area specifically invites PhD proposals. The matching doctoral research page supplies a direct application/supervision pathway. This establishes a named programme research area without relabeling its academic group a department.
limitations: Programme entry is the broad Business and Economics PhD/MPhil family; only the PhD route is counted. Central overview lists business/management,economics and information-science doctoral wording without allocating exact diploma wording to this area.
Management Science and Operations is an academic group and named doctoral research area, not an invented administrative department or separate independent degree.
Engineering branch remains incomplete; no extra award for each research topic.
